meta.name: benchling-integration
meta.description: Benchling Python SDK and REST API integration for registry entities, inventory, ELN entries, workflows, Benchling Apps, and Data Warehouse queries. Use when automating lab data with benchling-sdk or the v2 API.

copy.tagline: 自动将实验室数据集成到 Benchling
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经常在 Benchling 中手动操作数据
copy.tagline_en: Automate lab data integration with Benchling.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently manage Benchling data manually.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能用 Benchling Python SDK 或 REST API 操作实验室数据:创建和更新 DNA/RNA/蛋白质等注册实体、管理容器与库存、建立电子实验记录本条目、创建工作流任务、查询数据仓库,并配置 EventBridge 事件集成。
howto.when: 当你要求用 benchling-sdk 或 v2 API 自动化 Benchling 数据时触发,例如管理生物序列、库存、ELN 条目、工作流等任务。

say.text: 把容器 cont_abc123 转移到 box_xyz789。
say.note: 执行库存转移,更新容器位置。

say.text: 查询数据仓库中今年所有实验的统计结果。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude uses the Benchling Python SDK or REST API to manage lab data: create/update DNA/RNA/protein entities, handle inventory containers, create ELN entries, run workflow tasks, query Data Warehouse, configure EventBridge.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to automate Benchling data with benchling-sdk or v2 API—e.g., managing sequences, inventory, ELN entries, workflows, or Data Warehouse queries.

say_en.text: Create a DNA sequence 'My Plasmid' with bases ATCGATCG using the Benchling SDK.
say_en.note: Creates a new entity in Benchling.

say_en.text: Query the Data Warehouse for this year's experiment statistics.
say_en.note: Runs a SQL query via Data Warehouse API.
